1. Create a directory at /home/user/docs_project.
2. Inside /home/user/docs_project, create a text file named README.txt. This file should contain exactly three lines, each with a key-value pair about your project, in the following format (each key and value separated by a colon and a space as shown):

Author: Alex Doe  
Version: 1.0  

3. To verify your setup, generate a file named env_config.log in /home/user/docs_project. This log file should list the full absolute path of the README.txt file, one per line (no extra information, only the absolute path).

After you complete this, the directory /home/user/docs_project should contain both README.txt with the specified content and env_config.log with the path to README.txt.
